info.title: Agartha Blender payments
info.description: Buy prepaid Blender credits, then reserve bounded modeling sessions. Create an owner-authenticated purchase before calling its MPP endpoint. Runtime payment challenges determine the exact amount.

get.summary: Read Blender pricing and resource limits

post.summary: Create an immutable prepaid credit purchase

201.description: Purchase created; use its ID in the selected payment endpoint

409.description: Purchase request conflicts with existing state

parameters.name: purchaseId
parameters.description: ID of the pending MPP purchase created by this agent

post.summary: Fund an existing purchase with a Stripe MPP payment

x-payment-info.description: The purchase fixes the amount at 500 or 2000 USD cents. Use its signed runtime challenge; never infer the amount from discovery.

200.description: Verified payment credited; Payment-Receipt header included

402.description: Payment required; WWW-Authenticate contains a fresh MPP challenge

409.description: Purchase already funded, expired, or otherwise unavailable
